title: Animals of the Night: Bushbabies, Aardvarks and Owls
excerpt: When the sun sets, a different world comes alive: bushbabies, genets, aardvarks and owls. Where and how to see them.
body:
## Animals of the night

- **Bushbabies:** small primates with big eyes and loud calls.
- **Genets and civets.**
- **Aardvarks:** rare to see.
- **Porcupines.**
- **Owls**, including the Verreaux's eagle-owl.
- **Hunting lions and hyenas.**

## Where

On [night game drives](/blog/night-game-drives/) in concessions, and around camps in the evening.

## Sounds

Listen at night: lions roaring, hyenas whooping.
